operators.name: replication_pad2d_forward
semantics: Replicates reference ReplicationPad2d((pad_left, pad_right, pad_top, pad_bottom)) for a 4D NCHW tensor.
pad_left and pad_right apply to the width dimension (last), pad_top and pad_bottom apply to the height dimension.
Output width = input width + pad_left + pad_right; output height = input height + pad_top + pad_bottom.
Output values are obtained by clamping source indices to [0, H-1] and [0, W-1] respectively.
The contract parameters pass the same padding values as the reference module constructor (2,2,3,3).
Applies ReplicationPad2d with padding (2, 2, 3, 3) to input x of shape [16, 3, 4096, 2048].
The operation is purely a replication padding; no scalar arithmetic or reductions are performed.
